name: mcp-microsoft
description: Mail, Calendar, OneDrive, SharePoint, Contacts, and Teams via Microsoft Graph API for personal and enterprise accounts with multi-profile support
long_description:
Full Microsoft 365 integration for Claude Desktop. Manage emails, drafts, calendar events, OneDrive files, SharePoint sites, contacts, and Teams channels/chats/meetings across multiple accounts (personal Outlook.com/Live and enterprise Azure AD/Entra). Supports multi-profile authentication so you can switch between work and personal accounts seamlessly.

**96 tools** (plus 3 more — a drag-and-drop file upload app, `list_files`, and `read_file` — when Enable File Upload is turned on) covering:
- **Mail**: Read, send, reply, forward, search, move, and manage emails
- **Drafts**: Create, update, and send draft messages
- **Calendar**: Events, scheduling, free/busy lookups, and meeting time suggestions
- **OneDrive**: Browse, upload, download, search, and manage files
- **SharePoint**: Browse sites, document libraries, upload/download files, and manage SharePoint lists (work accounts only)
- **Contacts**: List, search, create, update, and delete contacts; manage contact folders and photos
- **Teams**: Channels, channel messages, 1:1 and group chats, online meetings, meeting transcripts, recordings, and Copilot AI insights (work accounts only; transcript/recording/AI tools are optional)
- **Profiles**: Add and switch between multiple Microsoft 365 accounts

client_id.title: Azure Client ID
client_id.description: Application (client) ID from your Azure App Registration. After saving, restart Claude Desktop completely, then ask Claude to 'authenticate on Microsoft 365' to sign in.

tenant_id.title: Tenant ID
tenant_id.description: Azure AD tenant: 'common' for personal + work, 'consumers' for personal only, or your org's tenant ID/domain

credentials_dir.title: Credentials Directory
credentials_dir.description: Directory for storing profiles and token caches. Defaults to ~/.microsoft-mcp/

enable_teams.title: Enable Teams Tools
enable_teams.description: Register Microsoft Teams tools. Requires a work/organisational account with a specific tenant_id.

enable_teams_meeting_artifacts.title: Enable Teams Meeting Artifacts
enable_teams_meeting_artifacts.description: Register Teams meeting transcript and recording tools. Requires a work account and extra Graph permissions.

enable_teams_ai_insights.title: Enable Teams AI Insights
enable_teams_ai_insights.description: Register Teams Copilot AI insight tools. Requires a work account, extra Graph permissions, and Microsoft 365 Copilot licensing.

enable_sharepoint.title: Enable SharePoint Tools
enable_sharepoint.description: Register SharePoint tools. Requires a work/organisational account.

disable_deletion_tools.title: Disable Permanent-Delete Tools
disable_deletion_tools.description: When enabled, hides all permanent-delete tools (delete_email, delete_event, delete_drive_item, delete_folder, delete_contact, delete_list_item, bulk_delete_emails, remove_ms_profile). Recoverable variants such as trash_email remain available.

enable_file_upload.title: Enable File Upload App
enable_file_upload.description: Adds a drag-and-drop file upload app (requires a client with MCP Apps support, e.g. recent Claude Desktop) plus list_files/read_file tools. Uploaded files can then be sent to OneDrive/SharePoint via the uploaded_file parameter on upload_file/upload_to_site.
